class_boundary: Local numeric results are seeded synthetic/analytic proxies; Groq is hosted 8b_proxy_for_4b; imported ClayGraph numbers remain their own evidence family.

experiments.setup: 20k synthetic epochs; ClayGraph C4 measured update/query-cost table used as interpolation seed; future reads heavy-tailed; read prediction lognormal noise sigma=.6
experiments.interpretation: Compaction should use update magnitude plus expected reads/read-amplification, not one change-percentage threshold.
Timestamped lazy decay can preserve touched values while eliminating global decay work; materialized low-salience state still needs pruning/GC.
Idealized proxy strongly favors one atomically published frame/epoch; not a live mixed-frame estimate.
Gated escalation retained nearly all constructed graph accuracy at about one-third of always-graph cost; target benchmark required.

Hash/basis/reader-version checks cannot detect trusted semantic miscompile; semantic/property validation adds coverage. Semantic catch-rate is a designed parameter, not measured production performance.
Exact-addressable backing plus uncertainty-triggered zoom occupies a useful accuracy/context middle point in the constructed workload.

setup.serialization: randomized role order; no positional leakage

experiments.interpretation: Randomized control removes the earlier leaky pairwise baseline: unlabeled flattening loses role information by construction.
Debt-aware maintenance lowered p95 but raised mean cost due to more rebuilds. One scalar maintenance-debt policy is not universally superior; mean/tail/write objectives must be explicit.
Nearly matched persistence can coexist with radically different causal task contribution; recurrence remains non-diagnostic for emergence.

trusted_candidate_projection.errors: q3 picked wrong min/max candidate; q7 unique candidate omitted

experiments.interpretation: Query-specific deterministic candidate projection improved proxy accuracy and token cost, but remaining errors show that deterministic reductions should be resolved by compiler/runtime rather than delegated to the model.

imported_fresh_independent_branch_result.note: Small-change delta overlay savings with growing read tax; 10% batch break-even ~974 later queries; at 20% rebuild already cheaper at update time.
0.0280 ms median lazy local activation vs 1.098 ms eager dense decay in that separate 30k-node proxy (~39x); not counted as independent G9 replication because G9 design directly consumed C4.
